messages:
Ravi T.: deploy-bot auto-held RC-21. vuln scan shows MEDIUM in data-proc/libdelta and an unsigned helper binary. tagging for triage.

deploy-bot: [scan-summary] RC-21 -> HOLD\n- vulns: data-proc/libdelta: CVE-2024-4242 (MEDIUM, heap overflow)\n- licenses: third_party/helperbin: signature missing, license: unknown\n- report: /artifacts/rc21/scan/1758000000/report.html

Lena (sec): MEDIUM; exploit requires crafted input we don't expect but we should not redistribute the unsigned binary. Option: build variant without helperbin and enable runtime hardening: `DELTA_SANDBOX=1` + `MAX_WORKERS=4` for canary.

Marco P.: We can produce a helper-free artifact and run a regional canary (EU only) tonight. Perf hit ~+15% p99. ETA for build + smoke: 90m.

LegalBot: Redistribution blocked until we get provenance or signed attestation for helperbin. Internal-only canary allowed if artifact removed and manifest proves it. Redistribution exception normally needs 48h review.

Ravi T.: Action items: 1) Marco - build no-helper artifact and upload manifest. 2) QA - smoke + perf (Lena will coordinate). 3) Sec - enable sandbox flags. 4) Legal - review manifest. If QA green we'll do EU canary 21:30-23:30 local. Rollback rule: any crash OR error >0.75% OR p99 >40% above baseline.

QA Bot: Quick test plan: smoke, integration, 5k sample. ETA 35m after artifact posted.

Marco P.: Build kicked. CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/9988. Will post manifest when done.

deploy-bot: tip:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-21 --reason "scanner hold"
/deploy promote rc21-nohelper --region eu --canary 2 --by @oncall
```

Marco P.: Artifact uploaded. manifest: /artifacts/rc21/nohelper/manifest.json. SHA: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe... (truncated). helperbin NOT included.

LegalBot: Manifest received. Internal-only EU canary approved. Redistribution blocked pending provenance.

Lena (sec): Sandbox flags set on canary: `DELTA_SANDBOX=1; MAX_WORKERS=4`. I'll run lite fuzz during canary.

QA Bot: Smoke + perf done: error 0.03%, p99 +16%. Recommend canary.

Ravi T.: Starting EU canary 21:32. Dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc21-eu-canary. Will evaluate at 22:30.

Lena (sec): Fuzz 20m: no crashes. sandbox stable.

QA Bot: 60m in: stable. error 0.04%, p99 +18%.

Ravi T.: Canary healthy. Legal still investigating provenance. We'll hold global redistribution until legal clears or vendor supplies signed provenance. Please add remediation ticket SEC-1623 and link this thread in notes.

LegalBot: Affirm. I'll follow up with vendor; if provenance appears we can fast-track redistribution exception. For now, staged EU canary only.

Marco P.: I'll add a feature-flag gated rollout so deploy-bot won't promote globally until `--redistribute-allowed` is explicitly passed.

deploy-bot: Unhold command (after legal sign-off): `/deploy unhold rc-21 --by @Ravi T. --confirm-redistribution`

Ravi T.: Thanks team, closing hold for EU canary only. Updating release notes to mention missing binary, perf delta, and SEC-1623. :white_check_mark:
